items.title: Plan board names no next action (no 'Next up')
items.fix: Under the tiles, one line 'Next: {n.n} {title} →' linking #/plan/<id> to the first Ready row in All work order (boardOrderOf over items). Hidden when nothing is Ready, where nothingReady already speaks.

With it, × updates the chips and shows Done, and nothing saves until Done, or a confirm names the effect ('changes the exclusions advice'). items.title: Troubleshooting opens with 'IAMAI is about to configure…' in internal runbook language, and the section the step points to is last of eight

Add a .catch at Connect.tsx:352. Keep note: W.account.note on the cancelled and failed states. Test in msal.test.ts and connectSignedOut.test.ts.

items.title: Rows say 'Waiting on your answers' without naming the question
items.fix: Add directionWords.waitingIn, 'Waiting on your answers in {step}', and return it with titleOf(r.reason.id) in holdLabelOf. On Hold then groups by the question's step, which is truer.

items.title: Two open tabs silently overwrite each other: the tab that saves last replaces the whole plan, even undoing a plan file the other tab just loaded

Another tab for the same tenant then enters a stale state: readOnly (planData skips persisting) with a banner 'This plan changed in another tab. Reload to see it.' and a Reload button (new keys). Per-field merging is out of scope. Test: planData stale flag blocks persist.

items.title: A saved change freeze has no visible effect on the plan rows, the finish tip, the PDF or the calendar
items.fix: Engine: make the forecast (roadmap/forecast.ts) push every turn-on or enforcing estimate and every Cleanup day out of the freeze and the working day before it, as schedule.ts placement does. Use the existing critical.freeze reason in the tip when the freeze moved the finish. Cheap interim (XS, low risk): while a pause is saved, add a line under the tiles: 'Paused {from} to {to}: nothing is turned on in this window.'

items.title: Tile counts and state words don't match the rows, and the legend defines only half of them: 'Needs your input 6' against 11 'Waiting on your answers' rows, an 'Observing' tile whose row says 'On Hold · Report-only', and undefined 'Correct' and 'Enforced'
items.fix: Content only: add legend entries for Create, Correct, Decision, Review, Turn on and for the chips ('Enforced' / 'Report-only' = what the policy is set to today). Rename summary.observing to 'In report-only' so it matches the chip, and add a tip on Needs your input: 'questions you can answer now; rows marked Waiting on your answers open once they are saved'. items.title: The MFA Readiness headline reads as if 29 people and a guest are ready

items.title: The home page never says 'read-only' or names MFA and Conditional Access beside its buttons, and its no-change promise sits below the fold
items.fix: Make heroMeta[1] read 'Read-only: you review and make the changes', or add 'Read-only' as its own item. Rebuild home and update home.test.ts.

items.title: On first view nothing says where to start; the guidance is hidden behind 'How to use this plan +'

items.title: Demo banner scrolls away while the header stays, so a scrolled plan no longer says it is sample data

items.title: The demo's 'Initial scan / Follow-up scan' switch is unexplained, and its styling is backwards: the selected option looks like a link and the other barely looks clickable
items.fix: Restyle .demo-snapshots as a two-segment control: a border, the selected segment filled brand-soft, the unselected one clearly a button. Add one visible phrase from a new key, e.g. 'Two scans of the same sample tenant, weeks apart'. The aria-pressed semantics are already right. CSS and content only.

items.title: Plan, MFA Readiness and Export in the header stop working before the first scan and during every rescan, look the same as live links, and say 'after the first scan' even when a plan exists
items.fix: AppShell.tsx:225: tabsOn = state === 'scanned' || (state === 'scanning' && snapshot !== null). This also restores aria-current on Plan during a rescan. Optional: make the disabled tabs visibly distinct (e.g. opacity/strike). Test in sessionTruth or a new shell test.

items.title: A printed plan made from an old scan drops the screen's 'Scan again before acting' warning
items.fix: In the brief cover, add the scan date (reuse app.print.cover.scanned + absoluteDate(scanAt)), and when scanAgeDays(scanAt) >= STALE_SCAN_DAYS print SHELL.staleEvidence under the status line. Optionally add a scan-date line to each ICS description.

items.title: Connect sample card '9 weeks' vs sample plan 'Est. Oct 29'
items.fix: Count weeks from snapshot.asOf rather than schedule.start, since the facts are computed at build time and a date would go stale. The label could read 'to finish from today'.

items.title: Legend omits suffixes and tags
items.fix: Add two legend items. 'Ready · Create / Correct / Turn on / Decision / Review': the kind of next action. 'Report-only / Enforced': the policy's state in the tenant today, so On Hold beside Enforced means the policy is on but the step still has work. Move 'Legend' into content.

items.title: Exempting partner and MSP technicians is suggested 'Yes', and the baseline's version is not shown at the decision
items.fix: Add a content key questions.partner.baseline (for example: the baseline's version asks partner and MSP technicians for MFA like any guest and blocks them outside your work countries). Show it as the card's note, or add it to chosen.yes, while the answer is Yes. Batch with F-067 and F-068.

items.title: 'Require Phishing-Resistant MFA for Admins' says 'change the Directory roles selection as listed below. Select (45)', and the list leaves out Global Administrator

items.title: 'Set up Windows Hello for Business' rows have no how-to in the Plan step they link to

Take the words from methodGuides and fill the names from the readiness next-step list. Test that the line appears only when someone's next step is WHfB.

items.title: The 'masked' calendar and prompts file keep guest sign-in addresses in full (43 in the calendar at 5,000 seats)

items.title: Owner ask: the Completed 'Difference Accepted' panel repeats fluff
items.fix: Delete ContentStep.tsx:1588 and :1590. Drop covers from AcceptPanel.accepted (acceptPanel.ts:94, :246) and the 'covers' key. Update acceptPanel.test.ts:73 and remove .accepted-covers from app.css:2531. Keep the pre-acceptance caption unless the owner says otherwise. Frozen only because it changes Completed steps (e.g. 4.3); the owner asked for it.

items.title: 8.1 Alert on Emergency Account Sign-ins waits until after the rollout
items.fix: Remove 'alerting' from AFTER_ROLLOUT. 8.1 stays in section 8 but reads Ready · Create now, and the forecast dates it with the rest (forecast.ts:489). Move the label to content.json.

items.title: A 'Ready' step is dated a month out and sits at the very bottom of the plan

(b) Keep it Ready and give it the Ready-review date, i.e. the phase's first day, in cleanupPhaseFor, so the forecast stays one source. Either way, update readyRowTruth/sectionEightFixes tests.

items.title: The printed plan omits the pinned baseline version, the deviations from baseline and the 'In the baseline, not in this plan' list
items.fix: Destructure baselinePin and add '(commit {pin7})' to the meta through a content key. Pass c.baselinePolicies into PrintPlan and render notInPlanRows(...) under 'Not in this plan' with the footer's own notInPlan/notInPlanRow words. Leave per-policy deviations on screen, since the briefing is for a manager.

items.title: '1 section was not read in full … check what is listed under Scan' leads to a row that explains nothing
items.fix: Give the Scan step its own lead that says what is known and the next step, with no 'couldn't read' wording, for example: 'Registered methods: {n} people not read; MFA Readiness lists them and the next scan retries.' The strip keeps 'listed under Scan'. Link each row: registeredMethods to #/readiness, the other sections to How's permissions.

items.title: Jamie Brown's row says to use a passkey that the drawer says will stop working
items.fix: rowNote adds a note when a held credential has afterStep3 === 'no', e.g. 'Not on Configure Passkey Authentication’s list: register an approved key before it’s applied'. The note also goes into the CSV Next step. Rename 'Step 3' in panel.step3.* and panel.why.replaceKey to the step's title.

items.title: 'Summarise this plan for a non-technical business owner' prompt is grounded only on five cleanup items, with no MFA step in it
items.fix: Ground Summarise on the same manager-level facts as the briefing. Pass Export.tsx a compact block per board row: number, title, lane word, When, and the manager/brief 'does' line (printPlan.ts briefOf output), plus the needs list. Do not use the 70k-char Explain blocks. Label each block with its step title, not 'Cleanup'.

items.title: Search leaves matches hidden in collapsed groups and gives a dead-end empty state
items.fix: Open groups and sub-groups when q !== ''. Add credential names to searchText. When q is set, show is not 'all' and nothing matches, add a 'Search everyone' button that selects 'all' (new content key).

items.title: The Account menu explains neither action on screen, hides who is signed in to which tenant, and styles the destructive item like Sign out
items.fix: Do this in the same AccountMenu change as F-160/F-163. Add a menu header '{username} · {tenant}', a one-line visible helper under each item (Sign out: 'Your plan stays in this browser'; Forget: reuse the forgetTooltip text), a separator before Forget, and danger styling for it. New keys signOutHelp and menuHeader.

items.title: When an admin has to act (consent or a missing role), IAMAI names the need but gives the user nothing to hand to that admin
items.fix: On the consent and role states, add 'Copy a request for your admin'. It copies a new content template: the app name, the consentRows names or Global Reader, why IAMAI needs them, and for consent https://login.microsoftonline.com/{domain or organizations}/adminconsent?client_id=<msal clientId>. Add a cancelled lead: 'Nothing was granted or changed.' Everything stays read-only.

items.title: The AI Info brief for 'Configure Emergency Exclusions' says no exclusions group exists, while the same card shows the group as selected and verified
items.fix: For the exclusions step with a chosen group, use the package's verificationRequired or partial AI block ('Policies still missing the exclusion: …'). Or drop the package's own State line when the step's ex.exclusionsGroup is set. In aiGrounding, draw What to do as numbered lines, not joined with ' | '. Test that the brief never says 'no confirmed exclusions group' when the rail names one.

items.title: Loading a plan file silently replaces current decisions and recorded deferrals, with no preview, warning or summary of what came back
items.fix: After the checks pass, keep the parsed record in state and show an inline confirm: what the file holds against the current record (decisionsOf: answered decisions, deferred steps with their reasons, completions; the file's createdAt), with 'Replace' / 'Cancel' and a 'Save a plan file first' button. Call importPlanRecords only on Replace. After loading, announce 'Loaded the plan file saved <date>'. The words go in new app.export keys.

items.title: The Email tab's single Copy button copies the staff, admin and follow-up emails as one blob, signed 'IT', in a code-style monospace box
items.fix: Give each message its own copy box, with subject and body. Replace 'Contact IT' with the signature or a helpdesk variable. Reword the admin line: 'Admins still without a passkey or security key: {list}.' Add a comms test.

items.title: Approving a decision jumps to the next one while the 'steps removed' note sits off-screen, focus is lost, and a removed review step is never listed
items.fix: After the scroll at Plan.tsx:163, focus the opened row's heading (tabIndex -1). Keep the change line visible near the opened row until the next action, and append to it instead of replacing it inside one visit. Tracing a vanished Cleanup row under Doesn't apply here is a separate engine change (M, high risk); leave it out. Do not put the line inside the approved Direction cards: that would reach frozen screens.

items.title: Opening a step replaces the history entry, so Back skips the plan or leaves IAMAI, and the demo's Follow-up scan resets on reload
items.fix: Plan.tsx:170/460: pushState instead of replaceState. Back then fires hashchange, and the existing onHash handler (Plan.tsx:141) reopens or closes the step. Demo: before the first demoTenant() call, read the stored DemoSnapshotState.current and seed demoWeek2 from it, or keep the choice in sessionStorage. Test: pure check that openStep pushes; demo.test for restoring the selection.

items.title: You can mark your own admin account as a printer: it is the first search result, nothing warns, and approving takes it out of admin MFA
items.fix: In pickerUniverse, for mailDevices and the D2 serviceAccountsGroup universe, give administrators and the operator (derive/operator.ts operatorUserId, plus the snapshot's role holders) a why line and a chip badge from new keys, for example 'Administrator · your account'. Sort signalled accounts first. Add a reason line under Approve answers when a picked account is an admin or the operator.

items.title: Confirm What You Use explains only one direction of each choice, so the other answer's effect is invisible, including an MSP lockout risk
items.fix: Add keys serviceKeep ('Keeps {steps} on your plan.'), partner.chosenNo and a mail-device None line, and fill chosen for every option. Add a caution key shown when the answer is No or None while the question's basis is 'present'. Batch with F-041 and F-068.

items.title: 'Couldn't read' has no usable next step: 'Nothing to do' stays after a rescan
items.fix: For a person whose method list wasn't read, show the Plan's own line ('Set up a passkey in Microsoft Authenticator') and state what is known: the devices seen. Retitle the group to an action, e.g. 'Check their sign-in methods', with the Entra path Users → person → Authentication methods. Drop the 'couldn't read' words. personNext skips Unknown rows, so the Plan is unaffected.

items.title: The demo's Follow-up scan gives different results on repeat visits and shows the Initial scan's timestamp
items.fix: Anchor the demo clock once: store an anchor instant in DemoSnapshotState on first entry and compute offset from it for both snapshots. Give the follow-up a later scan by shifting week2 by +7 days over the anchor, or leave that out if fixture windows break. Test: calling demoTenant twice gives identical snapshots and the same completed count.

items.title: No baseline version shown next to the step or the 'Differs from the Baseline' panel
items.fix: Add a content key such as acceptDeviation.baseline, 'Baseline: Defense in Depth, pinned {commit}', and render it beside the Differs panel label and inside the Difference Accepted record. It could take the place of the 'Covers {items}' line the owner wants removed. Display only; the record's shape does not change.

items.title: After a rescan fails, Plan, MFA Readiness, Export and Inventory never say so; only Connect explains that the last full plan was kept
items.fix: In ScanLine, when state==='done' and gaps.length>0 on non-Connect routes, render one role=status line from a new content key with a Connect link: 'Your latest scan didn't finish, so this plan is still from {date}. Details on Connect.' Say the fact and the next step, never 'couldn't read'. Test in scanReturn/footer tests.

items.title: Connect says 'Ready to plan' for a 40-day-old scan while every other page says to scan again, and the warning is a small grey line that never escalates
items.fix: Pass the scan age into scanTile 'complete'. At STALE_SCAN_DAYS or more, add a caveat ('This scan is {days} days old. Scan again before acting on it.') with tone 'wait', so the strip no longer reads Ready unqualified. In AppShell, fill the age into staleEvidence, link it to Scan again (#/connect), and use a stronger key past 30 days.

items.title: 5.9 Reset Passwords for Medium-Risk Users has no path forward
items.fix: Add BLOCKED_LINE entries for user-risk and user-risk-medium, e.g. 'Report-only would have asked {names} to change their password. Have each sign in and change it, or review and dismiss the risk in ID Protection, then scan again.' Add a sign-in-risk variant. Clearing the gate on remediation would be a separate engine change.

items.title: 'Configure Passkey Authentication' names one account as affected and a different account as the one that would be locked out
items.fix: Make one reading of the at-risk accounts: either the card also lists lockedOut, or strandedSentence reads the card's set. Pluralise 'those accounts' by count. Test that the card and the sentence name the same accounts on the demo.

items.title: The Plan tells the signed-in admin, the only Global Administrator, to disable their own account as dormant
items.fix: Leave input.operatorUserId out of `dormant` at generate.ts:1416: the account that just ran the scan is active by definition. Alternatively keep it but tag it 'you, signed in now' and offer no disable line. Test with ?operatorDormant: Dormant does not list u-1.

items.title: Home shows no product image and undersells the output
items.fix: Words now (XS): name the outputs in workLead or siteLine (a dated plan, exact changes per step, a leadership briefing). Image (M): an owner-approved pack revision with one demo Plan-board screenshot, then update the manifest hash and build-home.

items.title: After the 'Ready now' tile is clicked, the Ready tab stays selected even while other tiles show On Hold or Completed rows
items.fix: In selectSummary, when a filter is set, also setTab(ALL_WORK_TAB), and have 'Show the full plan' do the same. The Ready tile keeps setting 'ready'. Test in planUsability.test.ts: after Ready tile, then Completed tile, the active tab is All work and togglesOf reads completed=true.

items.title: 'Show completed' and 'Show deferred' start on, so clicking them hides rows under an unchanged label
items.fix: Switch the label on state: shows.completed ? 'Hide completed' : 'Show completed' (same for deferred), with the words added beside BOARD's or in content. Drop aria-pressed if the label now carries the state, or keep the label fixed as 'Completed' with a check-style pressed look. Test the label follows togglesOf.

items.title: Three excluded baseline policies give no reason, and baseline names appear only in collapsed sections
items.fix: Add two REASONS entries (/\bAGENT\b/i -> 'agents'; /Admin Portal/i -> 'adminPortal') and two content keys with owner-approved words, e.g. agents: 'Controls for AI agent identities, a Microsoft preview. Not in this plan yet.' adminPortal: 'Blocks admin portals for everyone but admins. Held out of this plan for now.' Test: no demo row reads generic.

items.title: At 1024px wide the plan tabs overlap ('Up Next 8On Hold') and the On Hold count is cut off
items.fix: Either raise the stacking breakpoint for .plan-controls to about 1180px (search on its own row), or set .tabs.view-tabs grid-auto-columns: minmax(max-content,1fr) and let .plan-search shrink first (minmax(160px,1fr)). Add a responsive.test.ts assertion on the rule.

items.title: Keyboard focus is invisible on every filled primary button in the light theme
items.fix: Light theme only: .btn-primary:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--canvas), 0 0 0 4px var(--brand-primary); } (an offset ring). Mirror it in home.css for the home 'Open IAMAI' button. Adjust accessibility.test.ts so it accepts the offset ring for .btn-primary. Frozen because the focus look of Approve answers and similar buttons changes on finished steps' screens (CSS focus state only, no layout change).

items.title: Connect's permission list gives no scope names and no link to How's full permission table
items.fix: Draw {r.scope} beside each name. End the disclosure with a link to #/how#permissions, adding the id to How's details and opening it on that hash. New content key for the link label. Batch with F-149.

items.title: On Connect, keyboard focus reaches the permissions disclosure before the Sign in button
items.fix: Emit .connect-step-actions before .connect-step-body in the DOM and pin it with grid-column:3 and grid-row:1, including the narrow grid at app.css:4061, so nothing moves on screen. Or move the permissions details under the step's actions. Test the DOM order.

items.title: Plan empty states don't say which filter emptied the list and offer no way out: 'No steps match this search.' with nothing searched, and 'Nothing in this lane.'

items.title: Plan settings mixes instant-apply and Save, gives no confirmation, and says 'freeze' for 'Pause'

Disable Cancel edits when !freezeDirty.

items.title: 'Plan settings' and 'How to use this plan' are links that act as toggles

items.fix: Rewrite the tip: every account with a record in the window, emergency, service and shared included. MFA Readiness counts only people and guests, so it can be lower. items.title: No skip link: every page starts with the header, and the first Plan step is the 25th Tab stop

items.title: The theme stops following the computer's light/dark setting after the first visit
items.fix: Write localStorage only inside the toggle callback. With nothing stored, follow matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)') and listen for its change event. theme.test.ts pins only the key name.

items.title: Inventory heading outline skips a level and the info button is part of the heading
items.fix: Render an h2 with the InfoTip next to it, not inside it (a heading-row div). Make sub-table captions h3.

items.title: The wrong-tenant message names only display names, so two tenants with the same name read 'made for Contoso Pty Ltd, and you are connected to Contoso Pty Ltd. Nothing was loaded.'
items.fix: When plan.tenant.name equals tenantName, use a new key naming both primary domains (plan.tenant.domains[0] vs the snapshot's verifiedDomains[0]), or both tenant ids shortened to 8 characters.

items.title: During a rescan, Plan shows one small grey line that scrolls away, and nothing says the tiles and evidence may change
items.fix: .shell.shell-sticky .scan-line {position:sticky; top:var(--header); z-index:29; background:var(--canvas)}. Optional: prefix the line with a content key 'Rescanning: numbers update when it finishes' while lastScan exists.

items.title: Export claims JSON/PowerShell are on each policy step
items.fix: Reword: 'A policy's JSON and PowerShell are on its step in the Plan while it is still to create or correct.'

items.title: Emergency access accounts can be picked as service or shared-device accounts, and the card that offers them says they are already out
items.fix: In pickerUniverse, when stepId is PREREQ_STEP_ID.serviceAccountsGroup and the kind is accounts, drop mapping.breakGlassUserIds. Leave the emergency-account pickers alone. Unit test: searching 'Break' in the D2 universe returns nothing.

items.title: The admin-center instructions sit in an inner scroll box that hides the last steps, in the smallest text on the step
items.fix: On the task-anatomy preview, set max-height:none and keep Expand. Raise the list to var(--t-3) and the Task select and label to var(--t-2). Check the Establish Emergency Access steps (frozen) and Prepare Your Team at 1440px.

items.title: A key model added to the list is silently lost unless a second Save is pressed
items.fix: Save on Add and on Remove by calling onDecide with the new list, and delete the Save Additional Authenticators button. Add a role=status 'Saved' line. Move the strings into content.json. Test: an added model is still there after the step collapses and reopens.

items.title: The service-accounts step says 'the accounts you picked' before anything was picked
items.fix: Say 'chosen' instead of 'you picked' in why and doneWhen, e.g. 'the service accounts chosen in Identify Service and Shared Accounts (suggested until you approve them)'. Do not hold the step on the decision, which is engine work.

items.title: The account picker says '8 results' when more match, and already-picked accounts vanish from search
items.fix: Count shown.length. When it is over 8, use a new key 'Showing 8 of {n}: keep typing'. When the query matches only picked chips, show a new 'Already picked' key instead of No matches.

items.title: A decision row's due date has no 'Est.', so it reads like a completion date
items.fix: Wrap both returns in fillText(schedulingWords.estimate, {date}). Add a withDirectionApproved(demo) case to WHEN_CASES so the 'every proposed day reads Est.' test covers Ready · Decision rows. Changes the date word on 6.x Countries' row and rail.

items.title: Inventory is not in the top nav
items.fix: Add a Tab to #/inventory with SHELL.tabs.inventory after MFA Readiness (enabled={tabsOn}), and set readinessActive to route === 'readiness' only.

items.title: Completed steps still say 'After making changes, select Scan to update the plan.'
items.fix: Draw the note only when remaining.length > 0, and move the sentence into content.json. Update smoke and template-check to expect no note on Completed steps, and amend step-template.md.

items.title: No multi-tenant path: the tenant is barely visible, there is no switcher or guidance, and every artefact is tied to one tenant
items.fix: One route effect in AppShell sets document.title to '{surface} · {tenant} · IAMAI Planner' (new pages.app.shell key; shares code with F-145). Prefix CSV names with a tenant slug (DataTable csvName / READINESS_CSV callers). Optional XS: one How > Limits line saying IAMAI plans one tenant at a time and each tenant's plan stays in this browser until Forget. Leave answer reuse across tenants out.

items.title: The home page promises an inspectable baseline version but shows none and links nowhere
items.fix: At build time, build-home.ts reads the pinned commit and read date and fills the note, e.g. 'Pinned: commit 90d9b89, read Sep 25, 2026'. It links to the source repository at that commit. The words live in pages.home.

items.title: Plan search matches step titles only, so the people, accounts and policy names shown inside steps return nothing, and the empty state points nowhere
items.fix: XS part: when a search finds nothing, add 'Looking for a person or account? Search MFA Readiness →' (#/readiness) under the empty line (content key). S part: add a searchTerms field to BoardItem in boardReadingsOf, holding the matched baseline policy displayName and the tracked tenant policy name, and match q against title + terms. Test: 'Core - Grant - MFA for all users' finds Require MFA for Everyone.

items.title: After a scan the page jumps to the top, and 'what changed' is a truncated sentence that cannot be expanded or exported
items.fix: (1) In Plan, an effect on scan.snapshot.asOf sets moveTo.current = open when a step is open, so the row scrolls back into view once drawn. (2) Have planChangeLine return parts with full title lists, and render 'and N more' as a <details> or button that lists them all. Tests: observePlan returns every title; the Plan re-anchors after a snapshot change.

items.title: Script and payload style varies between steps, and IAMAI writes an unexplained tag into policy descriptions
items.fix: Pretty-print packaged JSON in packageArtifact (parse, then stringify with 2 spaces). Add one JSON-tab note from a new key: the description tag is how the next scan recognises the policy, so keep it. Do not make the tag optional. Unifying the script style is a separate M job in the package CONTENT.md files.

items.title: Export files carry no tenant or date in their names, and 'Accounts as CSV' saves as people.csv
items.fix: Add one helper exportFileName(stem, tenantSlug, date) that returns 'iamai-<stem>-<slug>-<yyyy-mm-dd>.<ext>'. Use it for every exportDownload in Export.tsx, MfaReadiness.tsx:455 and the DataTable csvName. Rename the stems to match the button labels (accounts, authentication, licensing, sign-in-countries). Update the tests that assert names.

items.title: A step link or saved plan cannot be opened without that tenant loaded, and nothing says why
items.fix: Before the redirect at App.tsx:325, save the requested hash in sessionStorage. After restoreSession gives an account, go to it once, then clear it. Connect's sign-in tile shows 'Sign in to open {step}' (new key; step title from content steps). Skip the plan-file viewer.

items.title: A refresh drops the Plan's tab, search, Work type and tile filter
items.fix: Per-viewer convenience: save {tab, focus.search, focus.workType, summaryFilter} to sessionStorage under a key per tenant, with try/catch, and restore it on mount. Or encode them as a query on #/plan?tab=onHold&q=… and teach stepFromPlanHash to ignore the query. Test the round trip in a pure helper.

items.title: Search says 'No steps match' or shows nothing when matches are inside a collapsed group or hidden as deferred
items.fix: (1) While focusActive, draw a group open if it has a match: clear toggled when search or workType changes (in the onFocus handler), or have groupClosed ignore presses made before the filter. (2) When shown is empty, count matches in applyFocus(items, tab, {...focus, showCompleted:true, showDeferred:true}). If there are any, say '{n} deferred/completed steps match · Show them' with a button that sets the toggle (content key). Tests on groupClosed and the hidden-match count.

items.title: Legend states and list groups use different names, and the legend cannot be clicked
items.fix: Render each legend item as a button that calls select(state) and scrolls to the worklist; the state show keys already exist. Put the state word in each group summary, e.g. before group-why, so the two vocabularies meet.

items.title: A person the Plan set aside ('Turn On Without Them') still shows as needing action on Readiness
items.fix: Pass the campaign step's preparation.followUpIds to ReadinessPage. Tag those rows 'Turned on without them' (new content key) on screen and in the CSV Role/Why. The state stays tenant evidence.

items.title: Readiness CSVs share one name whatever they hold: the page's Export CSV follows the on-screen filter, the Export page's copy holds everyone, and nothing names the view, tenant or date
items.fix: Use F-047's helper, with the Readiness view in the stem ('mfa-readiness-needs-action-<slug>-<date>.csv'). Put the button's privacy note in visible text, or reuse the CSV card's words. Fix it together with F-047.

items.title: CSVs are hard to use in Excel: no UTF-8 marker, a sample-data sentence in column A of every row, mixed blanks and dashes, and different header names for the same field
items.fix: XS part: prefix '﻿' in exportDownload when type is text/csv (after the watermark). S part: one empty-cell convention across the tables, and aligned headers ('Sign-in address'; country column 'Country').

items.title: The grounding bundle carries no dates, although its readme says it does
items.fix: Write plan.estimatedFinish = statedEstimate(...) (derive/finish.ts, as PrintPlan.tsx uses it) and give each step `when: boardWhenOf(step, waveStartOf(step), lane)` ('Est. …'), keeping enforcement.basis. Alternatively, reword the readme.

items.title: No page links to the right part of How, and its sections can't be linked to
items.fix: Give each details an id (permissions, reads, checks, packages). Generalise revealPackage to open the matching details, then scroll to it. Link How from Connect's partly-read row and from the Plan legend.

items.title: 'Every check' leaves out the checks behind most steps
items.fix: Rename the summary to something like 'Checks IAMAI runs on your tenant'. Add one caption group, 'How a policy is compared with the baseline', with four rows built from ACCEPT_WORDS().tags plus a one-line meaning each.

items.title: Inventory and MFA Readiness describe the same people's MFA state in different, undefined words
items.fix: Show the MFA_STATE text in an InfoTip on the Inventory 'MFA state' column header, or as a legend line under Accounts. Rename the readiness method title and filter to 'Needs a phishing-resistant method'.

items.title: The browser tab title never changes by page or tenant, and a surface change is not announced
items.fix: In AppShell, one effect on [route, tenantName] sets the title from SHELL.tabs[route] plus the tenant (new format key). On a route change (not a step deep link), focus the page h1, given tabIndex=-1. Share this effect with F-025 and F-147.

items.title: The Account menu doesn't behave like a menu from the keyboard: arrow keys do nothing, Escape from an item drops focus to the page, and the menu stays open after focus leaves
items.fix: Menu-button pattern: on open, focus the first menuitem; ArrowUp/Down/Home/End move between items; Escape closes and focuses the Account button; focusout outside ref closes; running an item or a route change closes. Put the key logic in a small pure helper and unit-test it.

items.title: During a scan and after a failed first scan, other pages still say 'Scan the tenant', Export tells a signed-in user to 'Connect a tenant first', and every link lands at the top of Connect with the Scan button off-screen
items.fix: XS part: Export uses account ? app.plan.needsScan/scanLink : scanNeedsConnect, the same as Plan. S part: one shared NoScanYet component reads useSession().scan. While running it says 'A scan is running' (new key), which links to Connect. When failed it reuses CONNECT.failed. Link to #/connect with a focus target on the Scan button.

items.title: Without P1, Readiness says it can't be measured for anyone, then lists three people as measured and counts people 'who signed in' after saying no sign-ins were read
items.fix: Without P1, lead with the known part: '{n} need a method; confirming the rest’s sign-ins needs Microsoft Entra ID P1'. Add a no-P1 countedLine and guests.count variant that make no sign-in claim.

items.title: Guest accounts appear under raw '#EXT#' sign-in names, which wrap to three lines in Readiness and repeat '(guest)' in the dormant list
items.fix: Add a helper that shows a guest's home address (user.mail, or 'x_domain#EXT#@t' → 'x@domain') and use it in the Readiness row and drawer. Doing the same in names.ts would reach the dormant step screen and needs the owner's yes.

items.title: Returning admin sees the full Connect hero + Global Reader explainer every visit
items.fix: Once signed in with a complete scan (done[2]), drop the lede and the account note, or move the note into the permissions disclosure. Keep both for a first visit. Check against the approved connect-v3 anatomy.

items.title: An answer changed on a completed decision is thrown away silently if the user leaves without re-approving
items.fix: While any card on a step with saved answers reads Not approved yet, show a reason line under Approve answers (new key, e.g. 'Your change is saved only when you approve it'). Add a beforeunload and hashchange guard while an edit is pending. Alternative: hold the draft in sessionStorage keyed by step id and directionDraftKey.

items.title: Labels a beginner cannot decode: an 'Inforcer' yes/no question with no explanation, and an 'AI Info' tab that is really a prompt to paste into an assistant
items.fix: (1) Add a one-line key questions.serviceHelp.inforcer and set it as the Inforcer card's note. (2) Draw implementation.aiWarning as a quiet line beside the AI Info copy button. (3) Move the two hard-coded 'Entra channel' sentences into content.json as 'Follow the Entra tab for the full procedure…'. Renaming the tab needs the owner's yes, because the label comes from the approved pack.

items.title: After Defer, Put back, Approve answers, picker Done, chip removal or Scan, keyboard focus drops to the page body and the user's place is lost
items.fix: After skip or unskip, focus the control that replaced the pressed one: a ref plus a useEffect keyed on step.status, focusing Put back or Defer. After picker Done or chip removal, focus the picker's search field. After Scan, keep the open step and restore scroll to it instead of 0. Keep the status line in place and update its text rather than inserting a new filled node.

items.title: After 'Leave the demo', Connect gives no sign that sample progress is kept, and the sample can't be reset
items.fix: Add 'Start the sample fresh' beside 'Try it with sample data'. It deletes only store rows whose id starts with DEMO_TENANT_ID (demoMode.ts:13, 26), then opens demoUrl(). Optionally add a line 'Your sample progress is kept in this browser' when a demo record exists. New content keys, and a test that no real tenant row is touched.

items.title: The Estimated finish (i) opens on hover, closes on click, and closes on Enter
items.fix: Add a pinned ref: click or Enter/Space sets pinned=true and opens. mouseleave and blur close only when not pinned. Esc or an outside mousedown unpins and closes. Focus alone may still open it unpinned. This is a shared component used on step screens (behaviour only, no words). Unit-test the state machine as a pure reducer.

items.title: Plan list rows and the Readiness person list look like tables but are not
items.fix: Readiness first: give each cell a visually hidden prefix from T.columns ('Devices seen: …'), or use role=table/row/cell with the head as columnheader, not aria-hidden. Plan: reorder PlanRow's accessible name to start with the title (aria-label = title · state · impact · when). Keep class names for walk/smoke.

items.title: The decisions use five different patterns, and Save Countries gives no feedback
items.fix: Quick part only: when onCommit is set, have Picker save on every pick. Give the ContentStep decision Save a saved state: disabled until something changes, plus a quiet 'Saved' line from a new key. Unifying the five patterns is L; defer it.

items.title: A plan left open doesn't notice time passing: two weeks on it still shows past 'Est.' dates and no stale-scan line, then every date jumps when you change page
items.fix: Add a useToday() hook that returns the display-zone day and refreshes on visibilitychange/focus and a 60s interval. Pass it into the plan compute key (planData/usePlanData) so a new day re-dates and shows the stale line. When dates move, reuse the PlanChanges line. Test the hook with a fake clock.

items.title: On a 5,000-seat tenant, '2,914 more' opens a 2,914-person list inside the step: the page grows from 5,500 to 132,000 px, with no search, paging, export or bottom collapse
items.fix: Cap account.more at about 50 lines, then add '+N more · Open MFA Readiness →' (readinessStepHref) when the step has a readiness scope. At minimum, give .emergency-account-more .emergency-account-lines a max-height of 20rem with overflow:auto.

items.title: 'Enforced' badge vs Entra's own word 'On'
items.fix: Chip an enforced policy with policyFact.on ('On') in factOf. Whether the lifecycle bar's 'Enforced' stage is renamed too is the owner's call. Sweep the tests that expect the chip text.

items.title: Same create appears in 3.6 and 7.3
items.fix: On a policy step still to create that the batch lists (the report-only step's reportOnlyBatch.create includes its id), add one line under the create task: 'Create the Policies in Report-only lists this one too: creating it from either closes both.'

items.title: Inventory tables sort but can't be searched or filtered, unlike Plan and Readiness, and have small layout inconsistencies
items.fix: Add one search input over ModelTable rows that filters on the model's cell text. Show 'and N others' in full or behind a <details>. Move Export CSV into a toolbar above each table, as Readiness does.

items.title: Inventory, the expert's best raw view, has no nav entry and no links to plan steps
items.fix: Nav (XS): add an Inventory Tab (new SHELL.tabs.inventory) and remove inventory from readinessActive. Cross-links (M): the Policies name cell links #/plan/<stepId> for policies a step's tracking.members owns, and the step's policy line links back.

items.title: Returning to MFA Readiness loses your place, an open person can't be linked, and a step opened from Readiness has no way back
items.fix: Save the scroll position and the open groups per hash in sessionStorage and restore them on mount. Add #/readiness/<show>/p/<id> in routes.ts to hold the open person, so Back closes the drawer. A '← MFA Readiness' link on steps would touch step screens and needs the owner's yes.

items.title: The sample data contradicts itself in places an expert will notice
items.fix: Generator: iOS devices registered, not joined; the printer typed as a member with no Entra-joined PC; svc-mailer sign-ins marked as legacy clients; app sign-in counts no higher than the total. Words: 'None registered now.' when a restore line shows. Check Quinn Ivanova's device-owner derivation separately.

items.title: Per-object instructions don't scale: 52 policies to edit by hand (156 numbered lines in a 370 px box) and 785 dormant accounts to disable one at a time, with no bulk path or tick-off
items.fix: Above about 10 objects, show one pattern line plus a checklist of objects with their last-scan state. Add a read-only 'Download list (IDs, names)' CSV through the existing export path, and an optional PowerShell tab for the admin to run.

items.title: Review Overlapping Policies at 60 policies runs three overlap sets into one 250-word sentence and gives a single form for all of them
items.fix: Render each overlap group from phase data as its own list with policies listed once (S, low risk). Per-set outcomes need the checkpoint keyed by set (persisted shape) plus a form per set.

items.title: Opening a step freezes the page for 1.8–6.5 s at 5,000 seats (0.15–0.34 s at 30 seats) with no loading state
items.fix: Render the step shell and rail first, and defer the heavy parts (people folds, per-object procedures) with startTransition or a lazy child that shows a short 'Loading step…' line. Profile on ?big=1 first.

items.title: Demo dates cluster on one day
items.fix: Stagger turn-ons by a weekly capacity (N policies a week) in roadmap/forecast.ts. The demo-only alternative is to spread the demo's progress so its waits clear on different days.

items.title: The 'Expand implementation' icon is an external-link glyph but opens an in-page overlay
items.fix: Add an 'expand' path to Icon.tsx (four corner brackets, e.g. 'M3.5 8V3.5H8M12 3.5h4.5V8M16.5 12v4.5H12M8 16.5H3.5V12') and use it at ContentStep.tsx:917 and :919.

items.title: Printing the Plan screen with the browser cuts the Estimated finish tile to 'Est. Oct 2'
items.fix: Add @media print { .plan-progress-tiles { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0,1fr)); } } or reuse the narrow-screen rule (app.css:5105-5107).

items.title: The 'What IAMAI reads' table in How cuts off its WHY column at 1024, 1280 and 1440 px
items.fix: Lower minWidth on gate (12 to 9rem) and purpose (18 to 14rem), and let the Permissions cell wrap, so the table fits 1008px. Keep the panel's scroll as the fallback.

items.title: Connect's permission table has a ragged second column squeezed into half the card
items.fix: Add .connect-step .permissions .tile-rows li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(9rem, 14rem) 1fr; } with the description left-aligned. Batch with F-081.

items.title: Connect's status bar repeats step 1, and its dot sits below the text
items.fix: Raise the specificity of .connect-status-copy { margin: 0 } (e.g. .connect .connect-status-copy) and align the dot to the first text line. Optionally, when the current stage is 0, have the strip say the next action instead of repeating the state.

items.title: The Display time zone list shows UTC twice and raw zone IDs
items.fix: Build options as unique(['UTC', ...zones]) minus the default's zone when zone==='' . Label the default from a new content key 'Browser time zone ({zone})'. Optional: show the label as zone.replace(/_/g,' ').

items.title: Copied tasks are Markdown and include IDs the screen does not show
items.fix: For Copy, drop the facts block or draw it on screen too. Strip '**' and turn [text](url) into 'text (url)' in a plain-text copy helper, leaving AI Info and the exports unchanged.

items.title: The two greens and the two browns in the readiness bar are almost the same colour
items.fix: Move s-device toward red-orange and s-ready toward a lighter green in the tokens, or add a title on each segment. Check chip contrast and the tokens test.

items.title: The error page's 'Start over' doesn't say what it does, and the way to report is plain text
items.fix: Relabel startOver 'Go to Connect (your work is kept)'. Render send as <a href='mailto:feedback@getiamai.com'> (split the address into its own key). Add role=alert and focus the h2 (tabIndex=-1) on mount. Name the file iamai-error-YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM.json and add BUILD_COMMIT to the bundle.

items.title: Unreadable groups show as 125 identical 'an unnamed group' rows in Inventory, while steps, pickers and the CSV use IDs such as g-003 that Inventory never shows
items.fix: Name a missing group '{unnamed} ({id})' via the object labels, and show the Id column whenever any row has no name.

items.title: How build stamp shows the UTC date
items.fix: Define __BUILD_TIME__ as the full ISO instant and format it with absoluteDate in the viewer's time zone.

items.title: Footer 'Follow me on LinkedIn' is personal in a product footer
items.fix: Owner call: reword it to 'Made by the owner' with the same link, or remove the entry. Then regenerate home/index.html, which home.test.ts guards.

items.title: Service-account names in decision chips wrap mid-name onto three lines ('svc- / mailer- / 1')
items.fix: Add .chip-name { white-space: nowrap; flex-shrink: 0 } and .chip-badge { min-width: 0 }. Or scope .direction-question .chip-select { flex-wrap: wrap } and give the badge its own line. The Picker CSS is shared, so check the other step pickers.

items.title: Without P1, Readiness still points into a plan that isn't there, and loses its only how-to link
items.fix: When planSteps lacks s-prereq-passkey-settings, show an admin-center path line instead (new key). Without P1, hide G.suggestion and footer.plan. Give the method group a How or admin-center link when no plan step exists.

items.title: After 'Show the next 50', keyboard focus stays on a button now 3,000 px off-screen, and the next Tab skips the 50 new rows
items.fix: After a load, focus the first new row's Details button (a ref keyed by the row index) and announce 'Showing {shown} of {n}' in a visually hidden role=status.

items.title: In the demo, 'Scan to update the plan' quietly switches to a pretend follow-up scan that completes work, and decisions, the user never did
items.fix: When scan() switches the demo, set a session flag and show one demo-only line in the banner from a new shell key: 'In the sample, Scan shows a follow-up scan: the work and answers in it are the sample's, not yours.' Clear it when Initial scan is chosen. Add a unit test.

items.title: Four places give four answers to 'are both emergency accounts outside the enforced MFA policy?', and 'Configure Emergency Exclusions' says 5 policies in one place and 4 in another
items.fix: Add excludeGroups: [] to the demo day-one MFA row (Graph always returns the array). The exclusions step then lists and counts 5, and the MFA step's add becomes that step's edit. Reword cleanup 'why' so it does not say the group is already in place. Re-run the demo and exclusionsStep tests and the step snapshots.

items.title: A deferral's required reason is never shown again (not on the step, the plan or the print), and deferring shrinks the progress total
items.fix: Show 'Deferred {date}: {reason}' on the deferred card from milestone.gatedBy and the skipped history date. Add the reason to BriefLine for aside rows and print it in 'Not in this plan'. Optionally add a sub-line to the Completed tile ('1 deferred'). Test the print and the card.

items.title: The Plan says 10 of 30 people are not ready; the linked MFA Readiness page, its CSV and the print say 21, 25 or 26, and no count names its bar
items.fix: When the page is opened from s-verify-mfa and the step is not complete, scope to preparation.missingIds instead of preparation.ids. Add a new planContext.notReady key: 'Filtered to the {cohort} {step} names as not ready.' The headline then reads 'x of 10'. When scoped, show footer.plan under the headline. The step screen and its link stay unchanged.

items.title: The demo, Connect and How never say how to remove the tenant data kept in this browser
items.fix: Add one sentence to the Connect removal line and to How > Where it runs: 'What IAMAI keeps in this browser stays after Sign out; Account → Forget this tenant deletes it.' These are content-only edits to existing keys. Update any publicTrust/connectSignedOut assertion that pins the old text.

items.title: Switching from a scrolled Plan to MFA Readiness keeps the old scroll offset, and Readiness has no sticky header, so the page opens mid-list with no heading or navigation
items.fix: In useHashRoute's onChange, when the resolved route differs from the previous one and the hash is not a deep link (#/plan/<id>, #/how#package), call window.scrollTo(0,0). Same-route hash changes (Readiness filters, step open/close) keep their position. Put the route-change logic in a pure helper and unit-test it.

items.title: Completion criteria and the AI briefing contain contradictions and stray text: 'except Core - Exclusions and Break-glass 1', 'for guests except Core - Exclusions and guests', and a stray 'strong:' line
items.fix: In aiGrounding, skip role-keyed lines on a single-member step, or use the member's title in place of the key. In policyFact, name the excluded guest types by their portal names ('service provider users') instead of w.guests. Test both on the demo guests step with the partner answer Yes.

items.title: The scan wait shows only the current section and elapsed seconds; the read-only line disappears, nothing says whether you can leave, and Stop or a reload silently discards the scan
items.fix: Keep ready.note in the scanning state and add a new key: keep this tab open, you can read How meanwhile. Show '{done} of {total} sections' from TOTAL_SECTIONS. Put role=status on the state line. Add a beforeunload handler while runner.state is 'running'. A Stop confirmation is optional.

items.title: Without P1, the calendar, prompts and bundle still export a 'Conditional Access rollout' that the screen says doesn't exist, including work that needs P1
items.fix: In Export.tsx compute noPlanLine(snapshot). When it is set, replace the calendar and prompts cards' buttons with that sentence (pages.plan.conditionalAccessNeedsP1), and make bundle.plan = { none: line } with no steps or cleanup. Keep the CSVs and the plan file.

items.title: Without P1, Conditional Access policies that still exist and still enforce MFA are ignored
items.fix: Export mirrors Plan and print: if conditionalAccessLicenceLine(snapshot) is set, render that Callout and offer no plan files, only the inventory CSVs.
